description: USB HID activity jiggler for CardputerZero

store.summary: Keeps a connected computer awake by simulating mouse and keyboard activity over USB.
store.description: Jiggler turns CardputerZero into a small USB accessory that keeps a connected computer from going idle or locking. Plug it into a host over the switchable USB port and it sends small, randomized mouse moves and/or key taps at an interval you choose - no software to install on the host. Everything is controlled from the five keys under the screen: start/stop, cycle between mouse, keyboard, or both, adjust the interval, and check status at a glance. Real HID output uses the standard Linux USB gadget interface (/dev/hidg0, /dev/hidg1); on today's desktop emulator, jiggling is simulated only, since CardputerZero hardware hasn't shipped yet.
